# Onboarding Flow
Date: 2026-11-03 | Duration: 50.119998931884766m

## Summary
The discussion covered funnel performance, onboarding design, data quality, and the demo experience. Onboarding completion is improving across cohorts, but most conversions remain below 15%, while data-source conversion exceeds 50%. Draft counts appear inconsistent, indicating a data-quality issue requiring attention. Usage intent does not consistently lead to follow-through, and setup paths should be explicit. Role-based onboarding flows remain under consideration. The proposed experience places a frictionless demo before onboarding setup, with a demo environment capable of supporting real-time data. Michael owns the marketing-linked demo, while Guy and Gabe are associated with wizard-design polish. A prototype review is planned for next week.

## Keywords
Onboarding wizard, Activation funnel, SDK integration, Interactive product demo, Persona-based onboarding, Feature flags
